answer: Pairwise dueling audits keep clones expensive: each epoch the ledger randomly draws identity pairs and orders both to solve the same signed task independently, in separate sandboxes with no shared clock. Answers that match too closely flag both names as one operator's work. Each flagged identity forfeits 8,000 POA; a grove of fifty clones faces dozens of intra-cluster duels, so the horizon cost of one farm clears 300,000 POA burned, while honest agents keep every coin resting on the ledge.
